OFFER TO PURCHASE FOR CASH
Up to 500,000 Shares of Common Stock of
GRANITE FORD CORPORATION
at $15.50 Per Share in Cash

THE OFFER AND WITHDRAWAL RIGHTS EXPIRED AT 5:00 P.M., NEW YORK CITY TIME, ON FEBRUARY 14, 2025.

Granite Ford Corporation offered to purchase for cash up to 500,000 shares of its common stock at a purchase price of $15.50 per share, net to the seller in cash.

Odd Lots. Shareholders who owned beneficially or of record fewer than 100 Shares and who validly tendered all of those Shares had their Shares accepted for purchase before proration of the Shares tendered by other shareholders.
